entities.summary: Maria Alekseyevna Kliundikova née Vadeeva is a Russian professional basketball player for the Toronto Tempo of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). She was selected 11th overall by the Los Angeles Sparks in the 2018 WNBA draft. She is the first player to debut in the league who was born after the WNBA was officially founded on April 24, 1996.
